question_title: LRU Cache Implementation with Personal Optimization
problem_statement: Design and implement a data structure for Least Recently Used (LRU) Cache. It should support get and put operations in O(1) time complexity.
output_format: Output list of values returned by get operations.

input_format: logs = ["dig1 8 1 5 1","let1 art can","dig2 3 6","let2 own kit dig","let3 art zero"]

sample_cases.expected: ["let1 art can","let3 art zero","let2 own kit dig","dig1 8 1 5 1","dig2 3 6"]

problem_statement: Given an m x n matrix, return all elements of the matrix in spiral order.

question_title: Valid Palindrome III with k Deletions
problem_statement: Given a string s and an integer k, return true if s can be transformed into a palindrome after at most k deletions.
